name: functions

scripts.test:rules: npm run build:test && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-sparta-battle --only firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 lib-test/test/rules/*.test.js"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:test && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-sparta-battle --only auth,firestore,functions "node --test --test-concurrency=1 lib-test/test/e2e/*.test.js"
scripts.audit:data:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-sparta-battle --only firestore "node lib/audit/cli.js --project demo-sparta-battle"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-sparta-battle --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.shell: node -e "console.error('RECUSADO: o shell interativo de funcoes nao consegue garantir FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST e FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST, entao o Admin SDK cairia no projeto real herdado de .firebaserc. Use: npm run serve'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.deploy: node -e "console.error('RECUSADO: publicacao ampla proibida. O runbook exige alvo seletivo, uma funcao por vez, nomeando o projeto explicitamente: docs/backend-predeploy-runbook.md secao 7.'); process.exit(1)"
